process_verification_scope: Original controller checks zero child exit before marking COMPLETE but did not save numeric exit codes. Missing codes remain unknown; independently check all complete artifacts, source versions, officialCSV, frame coverage, tracks and exited processes.
interpretation: All58 pre-existing behaviors now have complete7Test coverage. 23 cue pairs match every inference field except cue and independently Dev-selected head snapshot; all12unmatched original behaviors retained. Positive pair differences are not automatically 2-3independent innovations, four architectures, or a>=5point result. No Test winner is promoted.
metric_scope: HOTA/IDF1 differences here use the original39 headline rounded summaries. Full precision and every threshold/sequence remain in the unchanged276-columnCSV/47fieldviews. Equal HOTA alone is not exact track equivalence.
runtime_scope: Cached CPU replay only; full detector/encoder/point/IR-generation costs excluded.
